title: Section complex maps and resolution transports
statement: For a scheme morphism g:X→Y [def-pc-scheme], complexes K of O_Y-modules and L of O_X-modules, and q:K→g_*L, define pushforwardComplexSections g q V at each open V⊆Y by qⁿ(V):Kⁿ(V)→Lⁿ(g⁻¹V). Its commutation with differentials follows by evaluation of the complex-map equation. Define sectionHomologyClass K V p as the exact-evaluation homology comparison followed by the canonical cocycle class map theta of [def-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-open-choices]. For an injective resolution R of a module G on a scheme Z and a specified isomorphism a:Γ(Z,R)≅K(V), define resolutionSectionHomology R K V a p as the resolution homology comparison, the inverse forgetful homology comparison, and Hᵖ(a). Composing this last map with sectionHomologyClass recovers resolutionSectionClass. All maps are explicit constructions without chosen unproved data.

def pushforwardComplexSections {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y)
    {K : CochainComplex Y.Modules ℕ} {L : CochainComplex X.Modules ℕ}
    (q : K ⟶ ((pushforward g).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj L)
    (V : Y.Opens) :
    ((RingedSpace.openModuleSections Y.toRingedSpace V).mapHomologicalComplex
      (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj K ⟶
    ((RingedSpace.openModuleSections X.toRingedSpace (g ⁻¹ᵁ V)).mapHomologicalComplex
      (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj L
